g.text: Native CLIs · shared context · explicit control
NEW SESSIONS: ENFORCED / project writable; references read-only ·
Only the project is persistently writable. Approved references and
standard OS runtime trees are read-only; temporary HOME/tmp are
disposable. Other user folders and host procfs are hidden. Install
Forge outside the project. Bubblewrap is required; unsupported
hosts fail closed. Grants apply to NEW sessions; existing sessions
retain their old permissions. Network allowance exposes host
networking, not a provider-only firewall. Native Windows/macOS
